name: SDDF with Ellipsoidal Priors and Neural Residuals
definition: A method for predicting Scene-Level Signed Directional Distance Functions (SDDF) using an ellipsoidal prior to approximate coarse object shapes and a neural residual network to recover fine details, satisfying the directional Eikonal constraint.
summary: SDDF with Ellipsoidal Priors and Neural Residuals reconstructs 3D scenes using learnable ellipsoids for coarse geometry and neural networks for fine details, enabling fast, differentiable novel view synthesis without iterative tracing.
